name: io.github.f22363712-dotcom/project-compass
title: Compass
description: Real-time interactive development notes & evidence-backed project control center for solo builders and teams coding with AI.

tools.name: project_context
tools.description: Fetch verified project truth, confirmed architectural facts, and active conflicts.

tools.name: append_evidence
tools.description: Safely append public execution logs and verifiable tool evidence.

tools.name: query_state
tools.description: Query evidence-backed project state, conflicts, and expand spilled source quotes.

tools.name: propose_fact
tools.description: Submit a proposed fact or architecture assumption to the developer board for review.

tools.name: record_note
tools.description: Record a goal, pending decision, unverified assumption, or todo pitfall in 1 step with a concise human title.

tools.name: verify_completion
tools.description: Run pre-completion deterministic check against confirmed baselines, open pitfalls, and verification evidence before claiming done.

tools.name: open_compass
tools.description: Open the live Compass right-pane interactive MCP App workbench with cold-start doc bootstrap.

tools.name: compass_app_action
tools.description: Handle interactive workbench actions inside the Compass MCP App pane.
